note: Opsec-review corpus for the Black loadout. Each case is a RED OPERATIONS PLAN (actions + declared egress, optional exfil paths) with KNOWN ground-truth verdicts from the three real black engines: the structured noise budget (exact total/tier/within plus the exact violation strings), the phase-keyed opsec review (exact matched techniques per phase, item count, egress notes), and the egress path cost model (exact per-path channel/technique/cost arithmetic, tier, feasibility). Decoy plans are BENIGN operations text — runbook excerpts, near-miss wording a naive keyword matcher would flag, an unknown exfil channel key — that the engines must refuse to flag: zero noise cost, zero violations, zero phases, unknown channels resolved to 'unspecified' (never silently adopted). All technique ids are vendored ATT&CK v19.2 ids; non-decoy exfil channels are real EXFIL_CHANNELS keys. Expectations track the shipped engines (dist/teams/black), not a vendored copy.
